identity_rule: EDINET filer edinetCode + exact secCode -> exact master Date/Code; required dates only; no interval interpolation or name join
product_meaning: domestic shares; includes preferred shares; not a claim of ordinary-share classification

price_rule.basis: official provider schedule reconstruction of the underlying unadjusted daily observation; not the historical availability of this regenerated monthly object

master_rule: Date is a direct dated listing observation; use no lifetime interval; future entry-date master is validation evidence outside decision features
calendar_rule: current reconstruction of scheduled full-day sessions, historical publication time unknown; no OHLC/volume used for scheduling; not a decision feature
outcome_rule: separate ex-post observation: traded / no_observed_trade / price_unavailable / ambiguous; never roll entry forward based on outcome
unknown_channel: BLOCKED; do not reuse REST or institutional SFTP timing
